doc.md:
Values for the [`Settings:gtk-interface-contrast`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Settings#property:gtk-interface-contrast)
and [`CssProvider:prefers-contrast`](xref:gtk:Gtk.CssProvider#property:prefers-contrast) properties
that indicates the preferred level of contrast.

This information can be used inside CSS via media queries.

More values may be added to this enumeration. Unknown values
should be treated the same as `GTK_INTERFACE_CONTRAST_NO_PREFERENCE`.

unsupported.brief: The system doesn't support contrast levels
unsupported.md: The system doesn't support contrast levels
